items.title: 6.11.4 Calculating the entropy change of the system (reaction) (system ki entropy change ka hisab) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.11.4, printed page 138.

blocks.text: System ki entropy change nikalne ke liye yeh formula istemal karte hain:
Aayiye is reaction ke liye system ki entropy change nikalen:

blocks.latex: \begin{aligned} S^\circ[\ce{Ca_{(s)}}] &= 41.40\ \text{J K}^{-1}\,\text{mol}^{-1}\\ S^\circ[\ce{O2_{(g)}}] &= 205.0\ \text{J K}^{-1}\,\text{mol}^{-1}\\ S^\circ[\ce{CaO_{(s)}}] &= 39.70\ \text{J K}^{-1}\,\text{mol}^{-1} \end{aligned}
blocks.text_alt: S°[Ca(s)] = 41.40 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹; S°[O₂(g)] = 205.0 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹; S°[CaO(s)] = 39.70 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹

blocks.latex: \begin{aligned} \Delta S^\circ_{\text{system}} &= S^\circ_{\text{products}} - S^\circ_{\text{reactants}}\\ &= 2 \times S^\circ[\ce{CaO_{(s)}}] - \{2 \times S^\circ[\ce{Ca_{(s)}}] + S^\circ[\ce{O2_{(g)}}]\}\\ &= 2 \times 39.70 - \{(2 \times 41.40) + 205.0\}\\ &= 79.40 - 287.8\\ \Delta S^\circ_{\text{system}} &= -208.4\ \text{J K}^{-1}\,\text{mol}^{-1} \end{aligned}
blocks.text_alt: As ΔS°system = S°products – S°reactants = 2 × S°[CaO(s)] – {2 × S°[Ca(s)] + S°[O₂(g)]} = 2 × 39.70 – {(2 × 41.40) + 205.0} = 79.40 – 287.8; ΔS°system = –208.4 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹

blocks.title: Easy words mein
blocks.text: Har substance ki S° ko equation mein us ke coefficient se multiply karein: 2CaO ke liye 2 × 39.70, 2Ca ke liye 2 × 41.40. Phir products ka jama minus reactants ka jama.

Negative value batati hai ke system ki entropy kam hui (gas O₂ khatam ho kar solid CaO ban gayi). Phir bhi hum jante hain ke calcium oxygen se spontaneously (khud ba khud) react karta hai. Is liye surroundings ki entropy ka bhi role (kirdar) hai, kyun ke reaction hone ke liye total entropy change positive honi chahiye.

blocks.prompt: N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) → 2NH₃(g) ke liye S° values 191.5, 130.6 aur 193 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹ se ΔS° nikalein aur sign ka matlab batayein.
blocks.explanation: ΔS° = 2 × 193 – (191.5 + 3 × 130.6) = 386 – 583.3 = –197.3 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹. Gas ke 4 moles 2 ban jate hain, system zyada ordered ho jata hai. Reaction phir bhi 25 °C par hota hai kyun ke nikalne wali heat surroundings ki entropy is se zyada barha deti hai.

items: 2Ca + O₂ → 2CaO: 79.40 – 287.8 = –208.4 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹; phir bhi spontaneous, kyun ke surroundings ki entropy barhti hai aur total change positive hai.
